surface_value: Calcort is a steroid medicine. This can be prescribed for many different conditions, including serious illnesses. It is used to treat inflammation including asthma, arthritis and allergies; treat problems with your skin, kidney, heart, digestive system, eyes or blood; treat problems where your body has growths (tumours); suppress the immune system in transplant operations.
